title: He Sold 50 Shirts Without Owning One!

scenes.headline:
SAME $100.
DIFFERENT GAME.
scenes.narration: Two friends. One hundred dollars each. Same product. Very different strategy.

scenes.headline:
BUY FIRST.
SELL LATER.
scenes.narration: Alex spent all his money buying five T-shirts for twenty dollars each. He sold them for thirty. That's fifty dollars gross margin.

scenes.headline:
SELL FIRST.
MAKE LATER.
scenes.narration: Maya did the opposite. She showed buyers a sample and collected fifty paid preorders. Only after confirming demand did she place the production order.

scenes.headline: HERE'S THE MATH.
scenes.narration: Fifty orders at thirty dollars brought in fifteen hundred dollars. Production cost one thousand. That leaves five hundred dollars gross margin, before sample costs, shipping, fees, and refunds.

scenes.headline:
DEMAND BEFORE
INVENTORY.
scenes.narration: Same starting cash. Ten times the shirts sold. Preorders reduced inventory risk, but finding fifty buyers was the hard part. Which approach would you choose?
